findings.detail: Color(0xFFFFD700) (gold) and Color(0xFFCD7F32) (bronze) are used directly in _rankWidget(). AppColors defines no gold or bronze constants. Fix: add AppColors.gold and AppColors.bronze to app_theme.dart and replace the literals, or map to existing semantic colors.

findings.summary: AI conversation createdAt is overwritten on every save
findings.detail: _saveCurrentConversation always writes 'createdAt': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(), destroying the original creation timestamp on each message sent. Fix: load the existing createdAt from _conversations by _currentConvId and carry it forward; only fall back to DateTime.now() when creating a new conversation.
